Plugin support, privacy and terms

Plugins

Each flagship tool ships a plugin for local AI clients. These pages give each plugin's support details, privacy policy and terms of use. Every page quotes the tool's own repository files. A machine-readable list is at plugins.json.

IconPluginWhat it doesPages
ArticulateChecks prose locally and verifies host-model edits against protected spans. The checker makes no network calls; the calling model reads the text in the conversation.Support · Privacy · Terms
CanonSearch and read project context from a local database you choose, scoped to one project.Support · Privacy · Terms
CrucibleCheck claims against local evidence files and get a verdict for each claim.Support · Privacy · Terms
ForumPreview how a request would be routed and whether it is ready to run, before it runs.Support · Privacy · Terms
GatherRead local documents and get a digest receipt for each one your assistant can cite.Support · Privacy · Terms
IndexMap a local repository and find symbol definitions and references with file and line evidence.Support · Privacy · Terms
LearnPlan study sessions, record your practice answers and see what to review next.Support · Privacy · Terms
MnemeLocal memory in a SQLite file you choose, with provenance on every recalled memory.Support · Privacy · Terms
PlexusShow which local tools produce and consume each capability, and the route between them.Support · Privacy · Terms
RelayRun a local coding agent in a project folder you choose, using a model server on your computer or a hosted model API you configure.Support · Privacy · Terms
TelosCheck local workbench readiness and build proof packets a verifier can recompute.Support · Privacy · Terms
FlywheelCheck a Flywheel or Bulletin claim and get a source-linked evidence packet with measurements, false-success controls and each premise labeled checked, reported or unknown.Support · Privacy · Terms
